Use `Text.from_markup(item_text, emoji=False).plain` to compare the visible text without Rich markup tags. See the [Markup API documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
